_comment: BOOT TO AUX + NO IDLE MUTE - the build for a CarPlay/Android-Auto piggyback, never flashed. builds/aux-boot.json (aux-autoswitch + aux-boot-default + aux-boot-restore) is the confirmed boot-to-AUX baseline and is unchanged here; aux-no-idle-mute adds one edit that stops C_MODULE_AUDIO::RadioMuteManager treating the AUX no-signal flag (+0x168) as a mute source, so the AUX input is not held muted while the piggyback is quiet. It does not switch to AUX when a signal appears - nothing does, and that is not pursued (docs/AUX_SIGNAL.md). App-image only: no /USER_DATA payload, so paired phones, destinations and presets are untouched. Edit `package` and `out` to your paths.
